headline: Daily market snapshot August 27 2026
summary: End-of-day market snapshot for August 27, 2026. US equities gained modestly on NVIDIA earnings euphoria; bonds steady ahead of Jackson Hole; oil lower on Iran sanctions relief; BTC near $79K.

headline: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 earnings beat: revenue $96.2B, EPS $2.22, Q3 guidance $108B
summary: NVIDIA reported Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.22 billion, beating the $92.17B consensus estimate, with adjusted EPS of $2.22 versus the $2.10 expected. Data center revenue hit $89B, up 117% year-over-year. The company guided Q3 revenue to $108B ±2%, above estimates, with GAAP gross margin of 75%.
key_facts: CEO Jensen Huang: AI 'reached its inflection point'
Hyperscaler capex expected to reach $1.3T next year vs $800B in 2026

headline: Nvidia stock rises 6% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
summary: Shares of NVIDIA surged approximately 6% in premarket trading on August 27, 2026 following the company's Q2 FY2027 earnings beat, breaking a four-quarter streak of post-earnings declines. The stock had closed at $209.91 the prior day before jumping on the results.
key_facts: After-hours low of $206.36 initially, then reversed higher
Stock had declined after each of prior four earnings beats

headline: Amazon AWS to buy 2 million NVIDIA GPUs, deploy Vera CPUs in Rubin integration
summary: Amazon Web Services announced it will purchase 2 million NVIDIA GPUs and deploy the company's new Vera CPUs, some of which will be integrated with NVIDIA's forthcoming Rubin AI chip architecture. The deal underscores sustained hyperscaler demand for NVIDIA's data-center products heading into fiscal 2028.
key_facts: AWS to buy 2 million NVIDIA GPUs
Vera CPUs to be integrated with Rubin AI chip
Deal highlights ongoing hyperscaler AI capex cycle
Top-5 hyperscaler capex expected to rise to $1.3T next year from $800B in 2026

headline: Okta raises annual revenue forecast after Q2 beat; stock jumps 16.3%
summary: Okta posted Q2 calendar 2026 revenue of $805 million, up 10.6% year-over-year, beating estimates. Non-GAAP EPS of $1.05 was 8.9% above consensus. The company raised its full-year revenue growth outlook to 10-11% from 9-10% and lifted adjusted EPS guidance to $3.92 at the midpoint. Stock jumped 16.3% on the results.
key_facts: Full-year revenue growth guidance raised to 10-11% from 9-10%
Full-year adj EPS guidance raised to $3.92 midpoint
Q3 revenue guidance $815M midpoint (+0.9% above est)

headline: Cantor Fitzgerald raises Okta price target from $125 to $170, maintains Overweight
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald raised its price target on Okta (OKTA) from $125 to $170 while maintaining an Overweight rating following the company's strong Q2 2026 earnings beat and raised annual guidance.
key_facts: Follows Okta Q2 revenue beat and raised FY guidance

headline: Target Q2 2026 earnings beat: EPS $2.46 vs $2.33 est, comp sales +3.8%, raises full-year guidance
summary: Target reported Q2 2026 EPS of $2.46, beating the $2.33 estimate, on revenue of $26.54 billion above the $26.14B consensus. Comparable sales grew 3.8%, topping the 2.4% estimate. Target raised full-year net sales growth to ~5% and lifted GAAP EPS guidance to $9.90-$10.90.
key_facts: FY net sales growth guidance raised to ~5%

headline: Piper Sandler raises Target price target from $146 to $153, maintains Neutral
summary: Piper Sandler analyst Peter Keith raised the price target on Target (TGT) from $146 to $153 while keeping a Neutral rating, following Target's Q2 2026 earnings beat and raised annual guidance.
key_facts: Follows Target Q2 comp sales +3.8% beat and raised FY guidance

headline: US PCE price index rose 0.2% in July, 3.7% YoY; core PCE +0.2% MoM, +3.3% YoY; spending flat
summary: The July personal consumption expenditures price index rose 0.2% month-over-month, above the 0.1% forecast, and 3.7% year-over-year, matching June's annual rate. Core PCE advanced 0.2% MoM and 3.3% YoY. Consumer spending was flat after strong gains in May-June, giving the Fed some room to hold rates.
key_facts: Real consumer spending flat in July after strong May-June gains
Markets pricing ~1-in-3 odds of September rate hike

headline: Fed Chair Warsh to deliver first Jackson Hole keynote Friday Aug 28 at 10am ET; markets pricing 1-in-3 September hike
summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh is set to deliver his inaugural keynote address at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium on August 28 at 10:00am ET, his first major speech as Fed Chair. Markets are pricing roughly one-in-three odds of a September rate hike amid sticky inflation at 3.7%, after the Fed held rates steady in July amid a rare three-way dissent in favor of hiking. Goldman Sachs warns of amplified FX volatility around the speech.
key_facts: Warsh keynote Friday Aug 28 at 10am ET at Jackson Hole
First major speech as new Fed Chair
July Fed meeting held rates steady with 3-way hawkish dissent
Markets pricing ~33% odds of September rate hike
Goldman Sachs warns of amplified FX volatility

headline: Fed July meeting saw rare 3-way hawkish dissent; Hammack, Kashkari, Logan voted for rate hike
summary: The Fed's July 29 decision to hold interest rates steady was accompanied by a rare three-way dissent, with Cleveland's Beth Hammack, Minneapolis's Neel Kashkari, and Dallas's Lorie Logan all voting for a rate hike — the first such split since 2016. The dissent underscores divisions within the Fed as Warsh prepares his Jackson Hole address.
key_facts: Fed held rates in July 29 meeting
Three dissents for rate hike: Hammack (Cleveland), Kashkari (Minneapolis), Logan (Dallas)
Backdrop for Warsh's Aug 28 Jackson Hole speech

headline: Canada announces retaliatory tariffs on 700+ US goods effective September 8 after US imposes 50% tariffs
summary: Canada unveiled counter-tariffs targeting more than 700 US goods effective September 8, following the US imposition of 50% tariffs on a broad range of Canadian imports effective August 22. The counter-tariffs target US steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper, and electronics. Negotiations broke down after Trump set conditions Canada deemed unacceptable.
key_facts: US 50% tariffs on Canadian goods took effect August 22, 2026
Canada counter-tariffs on 700+ goods effective September 8
Counter-tariffs target US steel, dairy, appliances, agri equipment
PM Carney: Trump set unacceptable conditions despite earlier positive talks

headline: Operation Economic Outcast: US sanctions 60+ Iran-linked targets; oil slips as market sees muted impact
summary: The US launched Operation Economic Outcast on August 24, sanctioning more than 60 targets linked to Iran's military and petroleum trading networks. Treasury Secretary Bessent compared the initiative to a 'D-Day economic onslaught.' Oil prices fell to multi-week lows as traders concluded the policy keeps tanker flows largely intact, with analysts projecting Brent between $70-$100/bbl in H2 2026.
key_facts: 60+ targets sanctioned across Iran military and petroleum traders
Treasury Sec Bessent: 'economic onslaught against Iran's financial connections'
Oil fell to 1-week low on muted supply impact

headline: WTI crude falls to $81.36 on Iran sanctions relief expectations; Brent below $88
summary: West Texas Intermediate crude oil fell 1.06% to $81.36 per barrel on August 27 as traders bet that diplomatic efforts and Operation Economic Outcast sanctions would not meaningfully restrict Strait of Hormuz tanker flows. Brent crude traded below $88 per barrel, extending the week's losses to more than 7%.
key_facts: Iran sanctions seen as not threatening tanker flow

headline: Gold trades above $4,600 near three-month highs as investors hedge rate and geopolitical risks
summary: Gold held above $4,600 per ounce on August 27, 2026, near three-month highs, supported by persistent US inflation above the Fed's 2% target, uncertainty ahead of Warsh's Jackson Hole speech, and ongoing geopolitical risk in the Middle East. The metal briefly touched $4,647 earlier in the week.
key_facts: Supported by inflation (PCE 3.7% YoY), Jackson Hole uncertainty, geopolitical risk

headline: Bitcoin settles at $79,027 on August 27; Solana +5.76%, Ethereum +2.58% on Clarity Act optimism
summary: Bitcoin closed August 27 at $79,027, unwinding leverage from the prior week's push above $80,000. Solana gained 5.76% and Ethereum rose 2.58%, with the broader crypto market supported by momentum around the Digital Asset Clarity Act. Bitcoin's short-squeeze episode earlier in the week reached $80,894 before retreating.
key_facts: BTC hit $80,894 earlier in week (short squeeze)
Digital Asset Clarity Act momentum supporting crypto

headline: Moderna and Merck's mRNA cancer vaccine (intismeran) succeeds in Phase 3 melanoma trial, cutting recurrence risk 49%
summary: Moderna and Merck announced positive Phase 3 results from the INTerpath-001 trial of their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine, intismeran, combined with Keytruda in resected stage IIB-IV melanoma. The combination cut recurrence or death risk by 49% (HR 0.51) and distant metastasis or death risk by 59% versus pembrolizumab alone across 1,137 patients. The result marks the first late-stage mRNA cancer vaccine success.
key_facts: INTerpath-001 Phase 3 met primary endpoint (recurrence-free survival)
HR 0.51 vs Keytruda alone (49% risk reduction)
First mRNA cancer vaccine Phase 3 success
Regulatory filing planned 'in next few months'

headline: Morgan Stanley raises Moderna price target from $39 to $89, maintains Equal-Weight
summary: Morgan Stanley raised its price target on Moderna (MRNA) from $39 to $89 while maintaining an Equal-Weight rating, following the positive Phase 3 INTerpath-001 melanoma vaccine trial results announced August 19.
key_facts: Morgan Stanley PT raised $39 → $89 on MRNA
Follows Phase 3 mRNA cancer vaccine success

headline: Morgan Stanley raises Semtech price target from $175 to $195, maintains Equal-Weight
summary: Morgan Stanley analyst Joseph Moore raised the price target on Semtech (SMTC) from $175 to $195, maintaining an Equal-Weight rating. Semtech designs radio-frequency and high-speed interconnect chips and benefits from rising AI data center demand.
key_facts: Morgan Stanley PT raised $175 → $195 on SMTC

summary: Deutsche Bank analyst David Hoang raised the price target on ACADIA Pharmaceuticals (ACAD) from $37 to $38, maintaining a Buy rating.

summary: B. Riley Securities analyst Mayank Mamtani raised the price target on Denali Therapeutics (DNLI) from $30 to $35, maintaining a Buy rating.
key_facts: B. Riley PT raised $30 → $35 on DNLI

headline: FormFactor Q2 2026 record revenue $258.2M, up 32% YoY; EPS $0.82 beats $0.61 est
summary: FormFactor reported record Q2 2026 revenue of $258.2 million, up 14% quarter-over-quarter and 32% year-over-year, with adjusted EPS of $0.82 beating the $0.61 consensus. Management cited strong demand in DRAM, Foundry & Logic driven by High Bandwidth Memory and Co-Packaged Optics for AI and HPC. The stock has gained over 314% in the past year.
key_facts: Strong HBM and Co-Packaged Optics demand

headline: Marvell Technology reports Q2 FY2027 earnings after close August 27; guided $2.7B revenue, eyes $3B in Q3
summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) was set to report fiscal Q2 2027 earnings after market close on August 27. Management had guided Q2 revenue to $2.70 billion ±5% with non-GAAP EPS of $0.93 ±$0.05. The company pointed investors toward $3 billion in quarterly revenue for Q3 and fiscal 2027 full-year revenue of ~$11.5 billion (+40% YoY), with focus on a $12.2B custom chip deal with Google.
key_facts: Polymarket bet 88% odds of earnings beat

headline: Vertiv raises 2026 revenue guidance to $13.8-$14.2B, organic growth 27-29%; stock +12.8%
summary: Vertiv Holdings reported higher Q2 2026 revenue and raised its full-year 2026 guidance to net sales of $13.8-$14.2 billion with diluted EPS of $5.82-$5.92, citing accelerating AI-driven data center demand projecting 27-29% organic growth. Stock rose 12.8% on the update. The company also announced a collaboration with Bitzero Holdings for AI and HPC cooling infrastructure.
key_facts: AI data center demand driving cooling and power infrastructure needs

headline: Tesla (TSLA) +5.09% August 27; Cybercab robotaxi fleet launching in Austin; price $345.82
summary: Tesla shares gained 5.09% on August 27, 2026 to $345.82 as the company advances Cybercab robotaxi approvals in Nevada and Texas. Tesla is preparing to add the autonomous-only Cybercab to its Austin robotaxi fleet while also raising Cybertruck prices on several trims. Market cap stands at $1.37 trillion with a P/E of 325.
key_facts: Cybercab added to Austin TX robotaxi fleet
Cybertruck prices raised on several trims

headline: Alphabet (GOOGL) +1.18% August 27, trading at $342; 59 analysts Buy; avg PT $428
summary: Alphabet shares gained 1.18% on August 27, 2026 to around $342. The stock is up 13.79% year-to-date, outperforming Meta which is down 10.48% YTD. Average 12-month analyst price target is $428.07 with 59 Buy ratings and zero Sell ratings.

headline: NVIDIA CFO Kress: Top-5 hyperscaler capex to rise to $1.3T in 2027 from $800B in 2026
summary: NVIDIA CFO Colette Kress said during the Q2 FY2027 earnings call that capital expenditures among the top five hyperscalers are expected to reach $1.3 trillion next year, up from approximately $800 billion in 2026, signaling continued massive investment in AI infrastructure.

Cited by NVIDIA CFO on Aug 26 earnings call

summary: The biggest premarket gainers on August 27, 2026 included VNRX +84.58%, MERC +68.28%, and MIMI +34.44%. Semiconductor test and equipment stocks such as FormFactor also rallied strongly as a halo effect from NVIDIA's blowout Q2 results boosted sentiment across the chip supply chain. Vertiv Holdings also surged on raised data-center infrastructure guidance.

VRT surged on raised AI data-center guidance

headline: Boeing sells Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, Insitu subsidiaries to Archer Aviation; takes stake in eVTOL firm
summary: Boeing agreed to sell its Wisk Aero autonomous air taxi unit, SkyGrid, and Insitu drone subsidiaries to Archer Aviation while taking an equity stake in the eVTOL company and entering a technology collaboration agreement. The deal was announced August 10, 2026.
key_facts: Boeing sells Wisk Aero, SkyGrid, Insitu to Archer Aviation
Boeing takes equity stake in Archer

headline: Prudential plc H1 2026: IFRS profit after tax -27%; dividend +15%; $1.5B buyback expanded
summary: Prudential plc reported a 27% drop in IFRS profit after tax for the first half of 2026, though the company raised its interim dividend by 15% and expanded its share buyback program to $1.5 billion. Shares were declining in premarket trading following the mixed results.

headline: 10-year Treasury yield at 4.65% ahead of Jackson Hole; 30-year at 5.31%; Treasury buybacks ongoing
summary: The 10-year US Treasury yield eased to approximately 4.65% on August 27 after hitting a 20-month high of 4.75% on August 21, while the 30-year remained elevated at around 5.31%. The Treasury's bond buyback program, which expanded to $4B+ for 30-year bonds, has had limited success in pushing yields lower amid persistent inflation and record corporate AI-related debt issuance.
key_facts: Competing AI corporate debt issuance keeping term premiums elevated

headline: AI chip stocks surge on NVDA beat; Marvell reports today, Broadcom September 2
summary: The AI semiconductor trade rallied broadly on August 27 following NVIDIA's blowout Q2 FY2027 results, with NVDA up ~6%, Marvell set to report after close, and Broadcom due September 2 closing the AI earnings wave. AMD remains up 120% YTD despite recent pullback, and analysts see data center revenue more than doubling in 2027.
key_facts: AMD data center revenue projected to double in 2027
AI infrastructure capex cycle intact per NVDA guidance

headline: GeneDx Holdings (GXDX) drops in premarket as investors take profits after 81% three-month rally
summary: Shares of GeneDx Holdings Corp were declining in premarket trading on August 27 as investors took profits following a substantial 81% rally over the prior three months, making it one of the notable premarket decliners alongside the broader healthcare genomics sector.

Profit-taking after sustained genomics sector outperformance

headline: Southern Cross Acquisition II (SCATU) SPAC IPO raises $75M, begins trading Nasdaq August 26
summary: Southern Cross Acquisition II, a New York-based SPAC with ties to China, raised $75 million by pricing 7.5 million units at $10.00 each on August 25, 2026 and began trading on Nasdaq on August 26. The SPAC is seeking a merger target.
key_facts: Southern Cross Acquisition II SPAC IPO raised $75M

headline: US stocks close higher August 27: S&P 500 +0.42% at 7,673, Dow +0.83% at 53,195, Nasdaq +0.39%
summary: US equity markets closed higher on August 27, 2026 as NVIDIA's earnings surge lifted sentiment across the AI supply chain. The S&P 500 gained 0.42% to 7,673.04, the Dow Jones rose 0.83% to 53,195.36, and the Nasdaq gained 0.39% to 26,168.46. Tesla was a standout gainer at +5.09%, while Alphabet added 1.18% and Meta gained 0.72%.

summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang said during the Q2 FY2027 earnings call that artificial intelligence has 'reached its inflection point,' with the number of companies requiring large clusters of GPUs expanding dramatically. The statement reinforced bullish AI infrastructure demand across hyperscalers, enterprises, and sovereign AI programs.
key_facts: Jensen Huang: AI 'reached its inflection point'
Number of companies needing large GPU clusters expanding dramatically

headline: US Dollar Index slips to 98.84 ahead of Jackson Hole; EUR/USD ~1.16, USD/JPY ~159.28
summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) eased 0.06% to 98.84 on August 27 ahead of Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote on August 28. EUR/USD was around 1.16 and USD/JPY near 159.28. Goldman Sachs warned of amplified FX volatility around the speech.

Goldman Sachs warns of amplified FX volatility
